title: Resolution declaring August 23 as Slavery Remembrance Day
summary: This resolution declares August 23 as Slavery Remembrance Day in New York City, aligning with the UNESCO International Day for the Remembrance of the Slave Trade and Its Abolition. It recounts the city's history with slavery from the 1600s through abolition in New York State in 1827 and references several 2024 local laws addressing this legacy. The resolution does not create any legal requirements beyond the symbolic declaration.
